Events Hub

Seasonal and limited-time events gathered from the patch-note archive

The Events Hub collects the event guides found in the Archlight patch-note archive. Each section is organized as a player-facing guide, not as a patch-note announcement, so players can quickly understand how the event works, where to start, which currency is used, and what rewards were confirmed in the source notes.

Source ruleOnly mechanics, currencies, NPCs, access methods, and rewards found in the patch-note archive were added. If a detail was not present in the notes, it is not filled in here.
🎃

Seasonal Events

Halloween, Christmas, Easter, Anniversary, Autumn, and Valentine-style events with currencies, portals, shops, and activity loops.

🗝

Event Access

Event access is listed only where the notes confirmed it, such as depot portals, event NPCs, dungeon rewards, quest boxes, or monster drops.

🎁

Rewards

Rewards are summarized from the notes and grouped by shop, boxes, questline freebies, or participation rewards where available.

02

Halloween Event

Pumpkinchu, Jack the Pumpkin King’s Axe, Pumpkin Spirits, Demon Oak, candy, and Halloween boxes

The Halloween event centers around Pumpkinchu in the depot, Pumpkin Spirits invading Archlight City, Jack the Pumpkin King’s Axe, and the Demon Oak raid. The latest Halloween source also included Archlight’s 10th anniversary celebration through Pumpkinchu’s candy shop.

How to start

  1. Visit Pumpkinchu in the depot.
  2. Accept the special task to fight off the Pumpkin spirits attempting to possess Archlight’s inhabitants.
  3. Complete the task to kill 1 world boss. The source note lists this as requiring pre-awakening level 1000.
  4. Return to Pumpkinchu to obtain Jack the Pumpkin King’s Axe.

Main activity loop

01🪓

Empower your weapon

Use Jack’s Axe on your weapon. The notes state that only empowered weapons can kill Pumpkin Spirits, and in Halloween fashion, only auto attacks work against these enemies from 1 sqm away.

02👻

Fight Pumpkin Spirits

Pumpkin Spirits spawn every two hours around Archlight City. They drop Tier 1 Halloween Boxes.

03🌳

Unlock Demon Oak

After enough Pumpkin Spirits are defeated, a portal opens in the depot. Players with Jack’s Axe can enter and help chop down the Demon Oak and its pumpkins.

04🎁

Claim raid rewards

The Demon Oak area has no death loss, similar to a world boss. Participants receive 200 energy and a free Tier 3 Halloween Box. The note says this was the only way to obtain a Tier 3 box.

Currency and boxes

ItemConfirmed source details
CandyObtained from all 3 tiers of gift boxes, dungeons, and quests. Used at Pumpkinchu.
Tier 1 Halloween BoxDropped by Pumpkin Spirits. Contains candies, catch-up pouches, crystal coins, Small Pumpkin Mount Token, and Big Pumpkin Mount Token.
Tier 2 Halloween BoxPurchased from Pumpkinchu for 40 candies. The source lists candies, catch-up pouch, crystal coins, Small Pumpkin Mount Token, Big Pumpkin Mount Token, Gastly Mount Token, and Pumpkinsaur Companion Token.
Tier 3 Halloween BoxEarned from Demon Oak participation. The note lists candies, crystal coins, catch-up pouches, Small Pumpkin Mount Token, Big Pumpkin Mount Token, Gastly Mount Token, and Pumpkinsaur Companion Token.

Pumpkinchu shop and anniversary items

  • Pumpkinchu sells Archlight Keys, the 10th Anniversary Backpack, Tier 2 Halloween Boxes, and the Pumpkin Knight Outfit.
  • The 10th Anniversary Backpack is purchased with candies earned from Halloween activities such as dungeons and events.
  • The 10th Anniversary Backpack grants +10% Monster Essence gain, +10% Loot Rate, and +10 Attack Power.
  • If a player needs another Jack’s Axe, Pumpkinchu sells a replacement for 50 Archlight Tokens.
SourceHalloween and 10 Years of Archlight, Legacy, 2025-10-31. The 2025-11-14 note only confirms the event had ended.
03

Anniversary Event

Cake essence, cake event, anniversary monsters, cupcakes, Toby, and Anniversary Island

The Anniversary Event uses cake essence, the !cake command, Anniversary Monsters, Anniversary Cupcakes, and Anniversary Island rewards. The latest complete guide in the archive is the 2024 9th Anniversary Celebration, with older 2023 and 2022 notes confirming the same core cake-event structure.

Core loop

  1. Defeat monsters and watch for cake essence drops.
  2. Type !cake to collect cake essence, up to 5 charges.
  3. Go to a safe zone and type !cake event.
  4. Eat cake during the event to summon Anniversary Monsters.
  5. Defeat Anniversary Monsters to earn cake boxes and event rewards.

Cupcakes and regular events

During the Anniversary Event, regular events such as TDM, Bombs, Firestorm, and other event rotations award Anniversary Cupcakes. Players can visit Anniversary Island and exchange cupcakes with Toby. The note states that better event performance gives more Anniversary Cupcakes.

Anniversary monsters

While hunting creatures, players may summon an anniversary monster. The notes describe them as non-aggressive unless provoked, behaving like Loot Slimes, with health equal to 10% of the killer’s maximum health or mana.

Monster or reward sourceConfirmed rewards and notes
Anniversary MonstersAnniversary Cupcakes, fireworks, Cake Box, Deluxe Cake Box, Nordic Chieftain Outfits, Orc’s Jaw Shredder, and Goblin’s Trick-or-Treat Bag.
PinataHas the regular Anniversary Monster loot table and can also drop Extravagant Cake Box, Tearesa, Bottle of Champagne, Forbidden Fruit, and Shannon The Trader.
9th Anniversary BackpackGathers loot from Loot Slimes and grants +5% loot slime find chance while carried in the inventory.

Toby and Anniversary Island rewards

  • Deluxe Box.
  • The Epic Wisdom Relic, which increases all profession skills by +1 and has a 5% chance to yield +1 gathered material per node.
  • Crystal Sword Furniture, which increases the chance to find rare gathering materials by 50% for 23 hours and increases the chance for rare node spawns.
  • Freezing Fang Mount, listed as Tier 5 with 7% Monster Essence, 15 attack power, and 40 power.
  • Racoon Backpack, which works as a relic and grants 3% resistance and 12 attack power.
  • Holy Blossom, which increases slime rewards by 5% and increases the chance to get a rare slime.
  • Knightly Bed Kit, which increases attack power by 20.
  • Monster Cupcake Mounts, heirloom mounts with 8 versions and no bonuses.
SourcesAnniversary/Autumn Event 2024, Legacy, 2024-09-26. Anniversary Event & Autumn Event - Patch Notes, Abaldar, 2023-09-29. Anniversary Event, Balancement, Quality of Life changes and fixes, Abaldar, 2022-08-31.

Autumn Event

Vini, Autumn dungeon access, event tokens, and seasonal reward stock

The Autumn Event is a separate seasonal activity connected to the Anniversary Event. It uses Vini, an entrance ticket bought with Anniversary Cupcakes, a Wargate-like event area, event tokens, and Vini’s reward stock.

How to enter

  1. Go to the event portal and speak with Vini.
  2. Obtain an entrance ticket by trading 100 Anniversary Cupcakes with Toby at Anniversary Island.
  3. Use the ticket to access the Autumn Event dungeon. The 2024 note lists the event as once per day.

Activity flow

01🍂

Enter the autumn realm

The notes describe it as a mystical Wargate-like experience themed around autumn.

02⚔

Clear the monsters

Players defeat all monsters in the realm to prove their valor.

03👑

Defeat the final boss

After clearing the area, players face a final boss and then return to their hometown with event currency.

04🛒

Spend event tokens

Event tokens are exchanged with Vini for Autumn rewards.

Christmas Event

Santa questline, North Polified portals, Christmas Tokens, presents, and Permafrost Queen notes

The Christmas Event is built around the Santa questline, the North Pole, Christmas Tokens, Christmas Presents, dungeon and quest seasonal drops, and temporary Christmas portal gameplay.

Santa questline

The Santa questline is accessed through the green portal in the depot. Completing the questline makes the player a citizen of Santa’s town and grants several freebies.

Questline freebieConfirmed effect
Elf Backpack2023 source lists +0.75% Resistance and +3% Base Health/Mana Regen. The 2021 source listed +3% Resistance and +3% Base Health/Mana Regen, so values may be season-specific.
Tray of Milk and CookiesIncreases regen from potions and runes by 10%.
Reindeer Companion+2 to all stats.
Santa Knight OutfitListed as a Tier 2 HP/MP outfit in the 2023 source.

Daily gameplay cosmetics

  • Contribute to 3 World Bosses to unlock a free Brown Sled Mount in 2023. The 2021 note listed a Blue Sled Mount.
  • Complete 15 Dungeons to unlock a free Dark Red Sled Mount in 2023. The 2021 note listed a Red Sled Mount.
  • Complete 10 Story Quests to unlock a free Santa Immortal.

North Polified event

01❄

Find a Christmas Portal

While killing creatures, players have a chance to drop a Christmas Portal.

02🎅

Enter as Santa or Grinch

The portal sends the player to a North Polified alternate reality of the current location. Players enter as Santa or the Grinch.

03🎁

Find presents

Players have 30 seconds to find as many hidden presents, gifts, and Christmas themed items as possible.

04🪙

Earn Christmas Tokens

Christmas Tokens are awarded based on how many objects are found.

Seasonal drops and presents

  • Dungeon and quest boxes drop candy canes and Christmas Tokens during the Christmas season.
  • Christmas Tokens can be turned in at the North Pole for Christmas Presents.
  • The color of the present does not change the rewards.
  • Christmas Present rewards can be rewrapped by selling the reward to Johnny the Wrapper for wrapping paper, then wrapping a new present.

Confirmed present rewards

RewardConfirmed note
Christmas Snorlax CompanionUltra Rare, heirloom, +5 to all stats.
Christmas Yeti MountUltra Rare, heirloom, Tier 4 Attack Power.
Christmas Presents FurnitureSemi-rare, +4 stats for 23 hours, can be used for multiple stat categories.
Small Christmas TreeSemi-rare, +20 attack power for 23 hours. Five small trees can be exchanged for one medium tree at the Woodcutting Profession Station.

Permafrost Queen note

A December 20, 2023 changelog says the Permafrost Queen’s Reward Pool, also called the Christmas raid reward bag, was updated to drop Christmas Tokens.

Christmas Token competition

The 2021 Christmas Token Event tracked the top 10 Christmas Token earners until December 31 and listed over $1000 in coins as rewards, with tracking available on the Abaldar website under the Power Rank or PvP Honor section.

SourcesChristmas Event Starts Tomorrow, December 15th, Legacy, 2023-12-14. Changelogs 12/19, Legacy, 2023-12-20. Christmas Event, Abaldar, 2021-12-20. Christmas Token Event, Abaldar, 2021-12-22.

Easter Event

Easter Eggs, colored egg rarities, catch-up items, Easter Bunny exchange, and bunny reward notes

The Easter Event has appeared in different versions across the archive. The older full event guide explains Easter Egg drops, colored egg conversion, catch-up items, and the Easter Bunny exchange. Later Abaldar notes mention Easter Furniture Boxes, Easter companion changes, and seasonal bunny doorbuster items.

Egg drops and colors

  • All creatures during the Easter Event have a chance to drop Easter Eggs.
  • The notes compare Easter Egg drops to Gold Nuggets, with a higher chance from more difficult creatures.
  • Easter Eggs can be converted into one of five colors: yellow, green, blue, purple, and red.
  • The listed rarity order is yellow as most common through red as rarest.

Catchup Rune StoneCan only be used to upgrade a rune emblem to +8.
Bronze, Silver, and Golden Regrade KeysListed as possible catch-up rewards from colored eggs.

Easter Bunny exchange

Higher-tier players can exchange colored eggs with the Easter Bunny for rare rewards. The older source lists egg color costs in the order Yellow, Green, Blue, Purple, Red.

Later Easter notes

  • Abaldar donation notes list an Easter Furniture Box as a doorbuster, allowing the player to handpick 1 from 4 unique Easter furniture pieces.

Valentine’s Event

Patrick, roses, raids, Valentine rewards, and house contest notes

The Valentine’s event note centers on Patrick, roses, frequent raids, and a reward exchange. Separate notes also confirm a Valentine-themed house contest.

Patrick and roses

Patrick asks players to help him plan a special Valentine’s evening for Princess Sophia. During the Valentine event window, frequent raids drop Roses. Players can bring Roses to Patrick through the depot portal and exchange them for rewards.

Reward exchange

House contest

The Valentine’s House Contest rewarded decorated Valentine-themed houses. Listed rewards were 150 Roses and a House Decoration Winner Sword for first place, 100 Roses and the sword for second place, and 50 Roses and the sword for third place.

Florisa Summer Event

Sunflowers, Florisa’s Servant, Sunflower Jars, Staff of Florisa, and Florisa race

The Florisa Summer Event is a dungeon-driven summer event themed around the sunflower goddess Florisa. Players collect Sunflowers from Greater Dungeons and exchange them with Florisa’s Servant through the depot portal.

How to earn Sunflowers

  • During the Florisa Event, players receive a Sunflower as an additional reward every time they complete a Greater Dungeon.
  • Living Tokens can also be exchanged for 50 Sunflowers at the Living Token Exchanger.
  • Sunflowers are turned in to Florisa’s Servant through the depot portal.

Florisa’s Servant rewards

RewardCost or confirmed note
Sunflower Jar10 Sunflowers. Contains random items including Florisa staff pieces, Archlight Tokens, Legendary Key Shards, Upgrade Stones, Stat Stones, and other small rewards.
Golden Wings250 Sunflowers.
Yalahari Effect100 Sunflowers.
Mount of Florisa300 Sunflowers. Listed as a T3 mount with +1.5% HP/Mana.

Staff of Florisa

The Staff of Florisa increases healing from Potions and Runes by 30%. It is created by combining all 3 staff pieces: Staff Handle, Gem of Florisa, and Hilt of Florisa. The note lists each piece as a 0.5% chance from a Sunflower Jar.

Florisa race

After forging a Staff of Florisa, players receive a Letter of Florisa. The first 3 players to mail this letter to Gamemaster Knighter received a Statue of Florisa house decoration. The statue increases Archlight Token find by 100% for 12 hours and has a 23 hour cooldown.

SourceFlorisa Summer Event, Legacy, 2018-08-04.

Sarandiel Event

Goddess Herbs, dungeon chest rewards, sacred lake portal, and Sarandiel exchange rewards

The Sarandiel Event is a limited-time dungeon reward event. Sarandiel opens a portal to her sacred lake and asks players to bring Goddess Herbs, which are earned from dungeon chests while the event is active.

How to earn Goddess Herbs

  • Every Greater Dungeon or Solo Dungeon chest used during the event grants 1 Goddess Herb.
  • Players can also receive 50 Goddess Herbs for each Living Token turned in to the Living Token Exchanger.

Confirmed rewards

Sarandiel offers several different items in exchange for Goddess Herbs. The source confirms 2 new pairs of wings, 3 outfits, Archlight Keys, Legendary Archlight Keys, and 2 companions.

Reward typeConfirmed details
WingsTwo new pairs of wings. The note says each boosts +25% movement speed from normal wings, same as Royal Wings, but stronger than normal wings.
OutfitsPharaoh, Herbalist, and Trophy Hunter.
KeysArchlight Keys and Legendary Archlight Keys.
CompanionsBaby Jellyfish, +2 to all stats, and Baby Serpent, +4 to all stats.
SourceSarandiel Event, Legacy, 2018-04-24.
